title: Guided Plugins findings
description: What a review returns when it is asked for JSON (the text --json in the arguments, or a JSON schema supplied by the caller). One object per review; scripts/findings-convert.mjs turns it into SARIF, GitHub pull request review comments or a Markdown summary.

tool.description: The plugin that produced the review, for example clean-code, or guided for a combined review.

books.description: Plugin slugs whose rules were applied.

scope.description: What was reviewed: a git range, paths, or the working diff.

rule.description: The rule or smell, in the book's words.

book.description: Plugin slug the rule comes from.

why.description: The consequence, in one or two sentences.

fix.description: The smallest change that removes the problem.

anchor.description: Added by scripts/guided-review-ci.mjs: the text of the cited line, so a fingerprint survives a shifted line number. Reviewers leave it out.

disagreements.description: Combined review only: places where a secondary book disagrees with the primary one. Not scored as findings.

primary.description: Slug of the primary book, for example clean-code.

secondary.description: Slug of the secondary book that disagrees.

primaryRule.description: What the primary book says or asks for here.

secondaryRule.description: What the secondary book says or asks for.

resolution.description: The decision, for example: the primary book decides: split the function.

skippedByConfig.description: Files left out because of the ignore list in .guided-plugins.json.

truncated.description: Findings left out because of maxFindings.
